records.context: **Pure uncertainty ranking collapses onto one region of feature space.** The 100 most uncertain extracted image regions on a real laboratory microplate are routinely 100 near copies from the same two microplate sample positions — one ambiguity, labelled a hundred times, for almost the information of labelling it once. So the annotation work list is diversified by default (round-robin across microplate sample positions) and :func:`format_queue_summary` prints how many microplate sample positions the annotation work list actually covers. What that costs is stated plainly in :func:`build_queue`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#9
records.source: **Pure uncertainty ranking collapses onto one region of feature space.** The 100 most uncertain crops on a real plate are routinely 100 near copies from the same two wells — one ambiguity, labelled a hundred times, for almost the information of labelling it once. So the queue is diversified by default (round-robin across wells) and :func:`format_queue_summary` prints how many wells the queue actually covers. What that costs is stated plainly in :func:`build_queue`.
records.translation: **A classificação de incerteza pura colapsa em uma região de espaço de características.** As 100 regiões de imagem extraídas mais incertas em uma microplaca de laboratório real são rotineiramente 100 cópias próximas das mesmas duas posições de amostra de microplacas - uma ambiguidade, rotulada cem vezes, para quase a informação de rotulá-la uma vez. Assim, a lista de trabalho de anotação é diversificada por padrão (round-robin entre as posições de amostra de microplacas) e :func:`format_queue_summary` imprime quantas posições de exemplo de micro placas a lista do trabalho de anotações realmente cobre. O que isso custa é claramente indicado em :func:`build_queue`.

records.context: **The annotation work list is diversified by default, and that costs something.** With ``diversity='well'`` the ranked extracted image regions are dealt round-robin across microplate sample positions: position 1 is still the single most uncertain extracted image region, but position 2 is the most uncertain extracted image region in a *different* well, which may be materially less uncertain than the runner-up overall. You give up some per-item uncertainty to stop the annotator labelling the same ambiguity a hundred times — the failure mode of pure uncertainty sampling, where the top 100 extracted image regions routinely come from two microplate sample positions. If ``limit`` is smaller than the number of microplate sample positions, the annotation work list will contain roughly one extracted image region from each of ``limit`` microplate sample positions and none from the rest. Pass ``diversity='none'`` for the pure order, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` for other strata, or ``group_columns=[…]`` for your own — including a cluster id you computed from features, which is the more thorough diversification this trades away for not needing a feature matrix.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.build_queue#3
records.source: **The queue is diversified by default, and that costs something.** With ``diversity='well'`` the ranked crops are dealt round-robin across wells: position 1 is still the single most uncertain crop, but position 2 is the most uncertain crop in a *different* well, which may be materially less uncertain than the runner-up overall. You give up some per-item uncertainty to stop the annotator labelling the same ambiguity a hundred times — the failure mode of pure uncertainty sampling, where the top 100 crops routinely come from two wells. If ``limit`` is smaller than the number of wells, the queue will contain roughly one crop from each of ``limit`` wells and none from the rest. Pass ``diversity='none'`` for the pure order, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` for other strata, or ``group_columns=[…]`` for your own — including a cluster id you computed from features, which is the more thorough diversification this trades away for not needing a feature matrix.
records.translation: **A lista de trabalho de anotação é diversificada por padrão, e isso custa alguma coisa.** Com ``diversity='well'`` as regiões de imagem extraídas classificadas são distribuídas em rombo redondo em posições de amostra de microplacas: a posição 1 ainda é a única região de imagem retirada mais incerta, mas a posição 2 é a região de imagens extraídas mais indefinida em um poço *different*, que pode ser materialmente menos incerta do que o segundo lugar em geral. Se ``limit`` for menor do que o número de posições de amostra de microplacas, a lista de trabalho de anotação conterá aproximadamente uma região de imagem extraída de cada uma das posições de exemplo de ``limit`` microplaca e nenhuma do resto. Passe ``diversity='none'`` para a ordem pura, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` para outros estratos ou ``group_columns=[…]`` para o seu próprio - incluindo um id de cluster que você computou a partir de características, que é a diversificação mais completa que este não necessita de uma matriz de características.

records.context: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` drop any feature column containing a NaN. On a real database it often removes every ``pathogen_*`` column, because those columns are NaN for cells without a pathogen. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` drop any object row containing a NaN. Usually removes almost everything, for the same reason; offered because on a single-object-type export it is often exactly right. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Both write a ``layers['missing']`` boolean mask of the same shape by default, so imputed values can be told apart from measured ones; the boolean mask costs 1 byte per cell against 4 for the default ``float32`` ``X``.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#15
records.source: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` drop any feature column containing a NaN. On a real database it often removes every ``pathogen_*`` column, because those columns are NaN for cells without a pathogen. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` drop any object row containing a NaN. Usually removes almost everything, for the same reason; offered because on a single-object-type export it is often exactly right. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Both write a ``layers['missing']`` boolean mask of the same shape by default, so imputed values can be told apart from measured ones; the boolean mask costs 1 byte per cell against 4 for the default ``float32`` ``X``.
records.translation: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` soltar qualquer coluna de característica contendo um NaN. Em um banco de dados real, muitas vezes remove cada coluna ``pathogen_*``, porque essas colunas são NaN para células sem um patógeno. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` soltar qualquer linha de objeto contendo um NaN. Normalmente remove quase tudo, pela mesma razão; oferecido porque em uma exportação do único-objeto-tipo é frequentemente exatamente direito. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Ambos escrevem uma máscara booleana ``layers['missing']`` da mesma forma por padrão, de modo que os valores imputados podem ser contados além dos medidos; a máscara booleana custa 1 byte por célula contra 4 para o padrão ``float32`` ``X``.

records.context: **Infinities are treated as missing under every policy.** spaCR produces +/-inf from ratio features (a denominator of zero), and an inf survives ``dropna`` while destroying any scaling, PCA or distance computed from it. They are converted to NaN before the policy runs and counted separately in ``uns['spacr']['nan']['n_infinite']`` so the substitution is never silent.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#16
records.source: **Infinities are treated as missing under every policy.** spaCR produces +/-inf from ratio features (a denominator of zero), and an inf survives ``dropna`` while destroying any scaling, PCA or distance computed from it. records.translation: **Os infinitos são tratados como ausentes em todas as políticas.** spaCR produz +/-inf a partir de características de razão (um denominador de zero), e um inf sobrevive ``dropna`` enquanto destrói qualquer escala, PCA ou distância calculada a partir dele. Eles são convertidos para NaN antes que a política seja executada e contado separadamente em ``uns['spacr']['nan']['n_infinite']``, então a substituição nunca é silenciosa.

records.context: ``combat`` is the empirical-Bayes method of Johnson, Li & Rabinovich (2007). Unlike the four above it fits a *model*: every feature is regressed on batch indicators **and** on the biology named by ``covariate``, and only the batch part of that fit is removed. The per-batch location and scale are then shrunk toward the distribution of the same parameter across all features, which is what makes it usable on a laboratory microplate with few microplate sample positions where a per-feature estimate would be noise.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.correct_batch_effects#2
records.source: ``combat`` is the empirical-Bayes method of Johnson, Li & Rabinovich (2007). The per-batch location and scale are then shrunk toward the distribution of the same parameter across all features, which is what makes it usable on a plate with few wells where a per-feature estimate would be noise.
records.translation: ``combat`` é o método empírico-Bayes de Johnson, Li & Rabinovich (2007). Ao contrário dos quatro acima, ele se encaixa em um  *model*: cada característica é regredido em indicadores de lote  **e** na biologia nomeada por ``covariate``, e apenas a parte da amostra desse ajuste é removida. records.context: ``confidence`` is the probability of the class the model *chose*, so it can never fall below ``1 / n_classes`` — a two-class model is at 0.5 when it is maximally undecided, and a ten-class model is at 0.1. records.context: Planning and loading are separate. :func:`plan_crops` asks the database or the folder *which objects match* and reads no pixels at all: a ``COUNT`` and a ``SELECT`` of identifiers, or one ``scandir``. records.context: This addresses issue #15 ("measurements sometimes hangs"). Measure runs one worker per field and every append goes through pandas' ``DataFrame.to_sql``, which issues a ``has_table`` probe -- a read -- before writing. So each worker alternates read, write, read, write against one file.
records.label: spacr.database_concurrency.enable_wal_where_safe#1
records.source: This addresses issue #15 ("measurements sometimes hangs"). Measure runs one worker per field and every append goes through pandas' ``DataFrame.to_sql``, which issues a ``has_table`` probe -- a read -- before writing. So each worker alternates read, write, read, write against one file.
records.translation: Isso resolve a questão #15 ("measurements sometimes hangs"). Medir executa um worker por campo e cada append passa por pandas'  ``DataFrame.to_sql``, que emite uma sonda ``has_table`` -- uma leitura -- antes de escrever. Assim, cada worker alterna ler, escrever, ler, gravar contra um arquivo.

records.context: Under the shipped rollback journal that combination starves the writer. A reader holds SHARED for the length of its statement, and a writer cannot COMMIT until every SHARED lock is gone, so with enough workers there is almost always someone reading and the committing worker waits out its busy timeout and raises "database is locked" -- usually surfacing on the next process's ``has_table``, which is the statement in the reporter's traceback.
records.label: spacr.database_concurrency.enable_wal_where_safe#2
records.source: Under the shipped rollback journal that combination starves the writer. A reader holds SHARED for the length of its statement, and a writer cannot COMMIT until every SHARED lock is gone, so with enough workers there is almost always someone reading and the committing worker waits out its busy timeout and raises "database is locked" -- usually surfacing on the next process's ``has_table``, which is the statement in the reporter's traceback.
records.translation: Sob o diário de reversão enviado, essa combinação deixa o escritor faminto. Um leitor tem SHARED para o comprimento de sua declaração, e um escritor não pode aceitar até que cada bloqueio SHARED se vá, assim, com processos worker suficientes, quase sempre há alguém lendo e o worker comprometedor aguarda seu tempo limite ocupado e levanta "database is locked" - geralmente aparecendo no próximo processo ``has_table``, que é a declaração no traceback do repórter.

records.context: scratch database to create. It must not already exist (:exc:`FileExistsError`); missing parent directories are created, and a processing session that FINISHES leaves the file on disk along with any ``-wal`` and ``-shm`` sidecars, so every explicit run needs a fresh path. Omit it to probe a temporary database instead, which is removed after a clean finish. A processing session that RAISES -- a ``journal_mode`` :func:`connect` refuses, most often -- removes its scratch database either way: it never ran, so there is nothing in it to keep, and leaving one at an explicit path made the next run on it fail with :exc:`FileExistsError`. The one deliberate survivor is a worker that outlives the 30-second join deadline, whose database is kept for inspection.
records.label: spacr.database_concurrency.run_concurrency_probe#2
records.source: scratch database to create. Omit it to probe a temporary database instead, which is removed after a clean finish. A run that RAISES -- a ``journal_mode`` :func:`connect` refuses, most often -- removes its scratch database either way: it never ran, so there is nothing in it to keep, and leaving one at an explicit path made the next run on it fail with :exc:`FileExistsError`. The one deliberate survivor is a worker that outlives the 30-second join deadline, whose database is kept for inspection.
records.translation: banco de dados scratch para criar. Não deve existir ainda (:exc:`FileExistsError`); diretórios pai ausentes são criados, e uma sessão de processamento que FINISHES deixa o arquivo no disco junto com qualquer ``-wal`` e ``-shm`` sidecars, então cada execução explícita precisa de um novo caminho. Em vez disso, omita-o para sondar um banco de dados temporário, que é removido após um acabamento limpo. Uma sessão de processamento que o RAISES - um ``journal_mode`` :func:`connect` recusa, na maioria das vezes - remove seu banco de dados scratch de qualquer maneira: ele nunca foi executado, então não há nada nele para manter, e deixando um em um caminho explícito feito a próxima execução nele falhar com :exc:`FileExistsError`. O único sobrevivente deliberado é um worker que sobrevive ao prazo de adesão de 30 segundos, cujo banco de dados é mantido para inspeção.

records.context: Project to three (:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`). One pass over a fixed image data channel-to-RGB mapping. records.source: Project to three (:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`). One pass over a fixed channel-to-RGB mapping. Cheaper, but irreversible: once channels are mixed, no downstream column can be attributed to a stain, so a screen cannot tell whether a difference came from the parasite or the host channel.
records.translation: Projeto a três (:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`). Uma passagem sobre um mapeamento de canal de dados de imagem fixa para RGB. Mais barato, mas irreversível: uma vez que os canais de dados da imagem são misturados, nenhuma coluna a jusante pode ser atribuída a uma coloração, assim que uma triagem não pode dizer se uma diferença veio do parasita ou do canal de informação da imagem do hospedeiro.

records.context: **Geometric units depend on the run.** A 2-D run measures in pixels, but a 3-D run measures a volume, and with ``voxel_size_z_um`` / ``voxel_size_xy_um`` set it measures in micrometres — under the *same* column names, because :mod:`spacr.measure` deliberately does not rename ``<object>_area`` (renaming would break every downstream selector). Which one a row is in is recorded on the row itself, in ``measurement_units``. So the unit of a geometric column is a :class:`ConditionalUnit`: :func:`describe_database` reads ``measurement_units`` out of the database it is documenting and resolves it, and a caller who has no database says so and gets the condition spelled out instead of a confident guess. See :data:`MEASUREMENT_UNITS`.
records.label: spacr.feature_dict#3
records.source: **Geometric units depend on the run.** A 2-D run measures in pixels, but a 3-D run measures a volume, and with ``voxel_size_z_um`` / ``voxel_size_xy_um`` set it measures in micrometres — under the *same* column names, because :mod:`spacr.measure` deliberately does not rename ``<object>_area`` (renaming would break every downstream selector). Which one a row is in is recorded on the row itself, in ``measurement_units``. So the unit of a geometric column is a :class:`ConditionalUnit`: :func:`describe_database` reads ``measurement_units`` out of the database it is documenting and resolves it, and a caller who has no database says so and gets the condition spelled out instead of a confident guess. See :data:`MEASUREMENT_UNITS`.
records.translation: **Unidades geométricas dependem das medidas de execução.** A 2-D em pixels, mas uma execução 3D mede um volume, e com o conjunto ``voxel_size_z_um`` / ``voxel_size_xy_um`` mede em micrómetros sob os nomes das colunas *mesmo*, porque :mod:`spacr.measure` deliberadamente não renomeia ``<object>_area`` (a renomeação quebraria todos os seletores a jusante). Qual uma linha está em é gravado na própria linha, em ``measurement_units``. Assim, a unidade de uma coluna geométrica é um :class:`ConditionalUnit`: :func:`describe_database` lê ``measurement_units`` fora do banco de dados que está documentando e resolve-lo, e um chamador que não tem base de dados diz isso e recebe a condição soletrada em vez de um palpite confiante. Ver :data:`MEASUREMENT_UNITS`.

The Lorenz curves take raw gRNA counts pooled over a plate; this panel takes each guide's share of its own well divided by that well's equal split. records.translation: A estatística é a mesma, mas sua entrada não é, embora ambos sejam rotulados "Gini". As curvas de Lorenz tomam contagens  gRNA raw agrupadas sobre uma microplaca de laboratório; este painel toma a parte de cada guia de seu próprio poço dividida pela divisão igual daquele poço. No experimento de triagem tsg101, esses são 0,20 e 0,32 - os valores do painel são maiores porque a normalização pelo poço remove a dispersão entre poços que achata a curva agrupada.

records.context: The workflow passes the response as one row per guide-in-well, but the response is a property of the well -- on the reference screen `log_pred` has exactly one distinct value in each of the 610 microplate sample positions, repeated once per guide the well retained. Counting every row would count a 15-guide well fifteen times and give n = 1,945 for 610 independent observations, overstating the evidence three-fold and weighting the distribution towards microplate sample positions with many guides.
records.label: spacr.figures.distributions.one_value_per_well#2
records.source: The pipeline passes the response as one row per guide-in-well, but the response is a property of the well -- on the reference screen `log_pred` has exactly one distinct value in each of the 610 wells, repeated once per guide the well retained. Counting every row would count a 15-guide well fifteen times and give n = 1,945 for 610 independent observations, overstating the evidence three-fold and weighting the distribution towards wells with many guides.
records.translation: O fluxo de trabalho passa a resposta como uma linha por guia-em-poço, mas a resposta é uma propriedade do poço -- na triagem de referência `log_pred` tem exatamente um valor distinto em cada uma das 610 posições da amostra da microplaca, repetida uma vez por guia que o poço reteve. Contando cada linha contaria um poço 15-guia quinze vezes e daria n  1.945 para 610 observações independentes, sobreestatizando a evidência três vezes e pesando as posições da microplatia a distribuição da amostra com muitos guias.

records.context: No microscope lights a microscope field of view evenly. A lamp profile, vignetting in the objective, a tilted condenser and dirt on the optics together make the same cell measure brighter at the centre of the microscope field of view than at its edge -- routinely 10-40 % between the middle and a corner on a widefield screening experiment. Every intensity feature spaCR writes (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, the radial distribution, the texture image data channels that are computed on intensity) therefore carries a **position-dependent bias**, and because objects are not distributed identically over every microplate sample position, that bias does not average out: it survives into the per-microplate sample position aggregate, and from there into classification and regression as an effect that looks entirely real and is entirely an artefact of the optics.
records.label: spacr.illumination#2
records.source: No microscope lights a field of view evenly. A lamp profile, vignetting in the objective, a tilted condenser and dirt on the optics together make the same cell measure brighter at the centre of the field than at its edge -- routinely 10-40 % between the middle and a corner on a widefield screen. Every intensity feature spaCR writes (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, the radial distribution, the texture channels that are computed on intensity) therefore carries a **position-dependent bias**, and because objects are not distributed identically over every well, that bias does not average out: it survives into the per-well aggregate, and from there into classification and regression as an effect that looks entirely real and is entirely an artefact of the optics.
records.translation: Nenhum microscópio ilumina um campo de visão do microscópio uniformemente. Um perfil de lâmpada, vinheta na objetiva, um condensador inclinado e sujeira na óptica juntos tornam a mesma medida celular mais brilhante no centro do campo de visão do microscópio do que em sua borda - rotineiramente 10-40% entre o meio e um canto em um experimento de triagem de campo amplo. Cada característica de intensidade spaCR escreve (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, distribuição radial, os canais de dados de imagem de textura que são calculados em intensidade) portanto, carrega um viés **posição-dependente**, e porque os objetos não são distribuídos identicamente sobre cada posição da amostra da microplaca, esse viés não é médio: sobrevive no agregado de posição da amostra por microplaca, e daí para a classificação e regressão como um efeito que parece inteiramente real e é inteiramente um artefato da óptica.

records.context: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` each worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry, so a correction registered only in the parent is applied to no field, and the processing session completes without an error while every number is uncorrected. :func:`enable_illumination_correction` therefore does more than register the hook: it writes the model path to :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` and appends ``spacr.illumination:install`` to ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``, which every start method inherits, so each worker installs the correction for itself. :func:`worker_delivery_status` reports whether that is actually in place, and :func:`enable_illumination_correction` prints it.
records.label: spacr.illumination#13
records.source: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` each worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry, so a correction registered only in the parent is applied to no field, and the run completes without an error while every number is uncorrected. :func:`enable_illumination_correction` therefore does more than register the hook: it writes the model path to :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` and appends ``spacr.illumination:install`` to ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``, which every start method inherits, so each worker installs the correction for itself. :func:`worker_delivery_status` reports whether that is actually in place, and :func:`enable_illumination_correction` prints it.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` mede campos em um :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Em ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` cada worker é um intérprete fresco com um registro de gancho vazio, então uma correção registrada apenas no pai é aplicada a nenhum campo e a sessão de processamento é concluída sem um erro enquanto cada número não é corrigido. Portanto, :func:`enable_illumination_correction` faz mais do que registrar o gancho: ele grava o caminho do modelo para :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` e acrescenta ``spacr.illumination:install`` a ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``, que cada método de início herda, para que cada worker instale a correção por si mesmo. :func:`worker_delivery_status` relata se isso está realmente no lugar e :func:`enable_illumination_correction` imprime.

records.context: **Every panel uses one world-units-per-pixel scale.** That is the whole difficulty, and it is why this is a class rather than three :meth:`Canvas.covering` calls. Confocal stacks in this codebase are routinely 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z; a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin, and it does not look wrong — it looks like a slightly flat cell. Nuclear sphericity, colocalisation depth and every 3-D shape feature read off such a picture are wrong by a factor nobody sees. Here the side views are :math:`z_{span}/step` pixels tall, so a 10-slice 2 µm stack is 31 px of a 0.65 µm/px view, not 10.
records.label: spacr.layers.OrthoViews#5
records.source: **Every panel uses one world-units-per-pixel scale.** That is the whole difficulty, and it is why this is a class rather than three :meth:`Canvas.covering` calls. Confocal stacks in this codebase are routinely 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z; a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin, and it does not look wrong — it looks like a slightly flat cell. Nuclear sphericity, colocalisation depth and every 3-D shape feature read off such a picture are wrong by a factor nobody sees. Here the side views are :math:`z_{span}/step` pixels tall, so a 10-slice 2 µm stack is 31 px of a 0.65 µm/px view, not 10.
records.translation: **Cada painel usa uma escala mundo-unidades-por-pixel.** Essa é toda a dificuldade, e é por isso que esta é uma classe em vez de três chamadas :meth:`Canvas.covering`. As pilhas confocal nesta base de código são rotineiramente 0.65 µm em xy e 2 µm em z; uma vista lateral desenhada um pixel por fatia é três vezes muito fina, e não parece errada - parece uma célula ligeiramente plana. A esfericidade nuclear, a profundidade de colocalização e todas as características de forma 3D lidos em tal imagem estão errados por um fator que ninguém vê. Aqui as visualizações laterais são :math:`z_{span}/step` pixels de altura, então uma pilha de 10 fatias 2 µm é 31 px de uma visualização de 0,65 µm/px, não 10.

records.context: **Every download is checksummed, and verification happens before use.** A checkpoint truncated by a dropped connection, or swapped for a different one at the same URL, still loads. It does not throw; it produces silently different masks, and the run that used it looks exactly like the run that did not. So :func:`fetch` hashes what arrived and compares it to the hash the catalogue published: a mismatch deletes the file and throws :class:`ChecksumMismatch` — the entry is never registered. The hash that was actually computed is stored on the returned entry, so "verified" means "these bytes", not "this filename".
records.label: spacr.model_zoo#9
records.source: **Every download is checksummed, and verification happens before use.** A checkpoint truncated by a dropped connection, or swapped for a different one at the same URL, still loads. It does not raise; it produces silently different masks, and the run that used it looks exactly like the run that did not. So :func:`fetch` hashes what arrived and compares it to the hash the catalogue published: a mismatch deletes the file and raises :class:`ChecksumMismatch` — the entry is never registered. The hash that was actually computed is stored on the returned entry, so "verified" means "these bytes", not "this filename".
records.translation: **Cada download é checksummed, e a verificação acontece antes de use.** Um checkpoint truncado por uma conexão suspensa, ou trocado por um diferente na mesma URL, ainda carrega. Ele não joga; produz silenciosamente máscaras diferentes, e a execução que a usou se parece exatamente com a execução que não o fez. Então :func:`fetch` hashes o que chegou e compara com o hash do catálogo publicado: uma incompatibilidade exclui o arquivo e lança :class:`ChecksumMismatch` - a entrada nunca é registrada. O hash que foi realmente computado é armazenado na entrada retornada, então "verified" significa "these bytes", não "this filename".

records.translation: Uma cabeça é um modelo de classificação de aprendizado de máquina treinado: é entregue um lote de regiões de imagem extraídas e retorna uma classe e uma probabilidade para cada uma. records.context: The phenotype images are 2960x2960 at 20X and the sequencing images are 1480x1480 at 10X, of the same round well (phase A4 of the optical pooled screening experiment workflow). This step produces one transform per phenotype microscope field of view into the sequencing frame, aligned on the nuclear stain. It does not resample either acquisition into the other: the transform is stored and the pixels are left where they were, because resampling would lose information.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype#1
records.source: The phenotype images are 2960x2960 at 20X and the sequencing images are 1480x1480 at 10X, of the same round well (phase A4 of the optical pooled screen pipeline). This step produces one transform per phenotype field into the sequencing frame, aligned on the nuclear stain. It does not resample either acquisition into the other: the transform is stored and the pixels are left where they were, because resampling would lose information.
records.translation: As imagens do fenótipo são 2960x2960 em 20X e as imagens de sequenciamento são 1480x1480 em 10X, do mesmo poço redondo (fase A4 do fluxo de trabalho do experimento de triagem agrupado óptico). Esta etapa produz uma transformação por campo de visão do microscópio do fenotipo no quadro de sequenciação, alinhado na coloração nuclear. Não reamostra nenhuma aquisição na outra: a transformação é armazenada e os pixels são deixados onde estavam, porque a informação seria perdida.

records.context: Nuclei at 10X are round blobs. They have no corners, so a corner detector finds essentially nothing and the matcher's scores are noise. Phase correlation asks a different question -- what single translation makes these two microscope fields of view agree -- and a microscope field of view of blobs answers it very well. Feature matching is still used in one other place: the phenotype-to-SBS step across magnifications, where scale and rotation are real.
records.label: spacr.ops_register#3
records.source: Nuclei at 10X are round blobs. They have no corners, so a corner detector finds essentially nothing and the matcher's scores are noise. Phase correlation asks a different question -- what single translation makes these two fields agree -- and a field of blobs answers it very well. Feature matching is still used in one other place: the phenotype-to-SBS step across magnifications, where scale and rotation are real.
records.translation: Nuclei em 10X são bolhas redondas. Eles não têm cantos, então um detector de canto não encontra essencialmente nada e as pontuações do fósforo são ruído. A correlação de fase faz uma pergunta diferente - que tradução única faz esses dois campos de visão de microscópio concordarem - e um campo de visão do microscópio de bolhas responde muito bem. A correspondência de características ainda é usada em outro lugar: o passo do fenótipo para SBS em ampliações, onde a escala e a rotação real.

records.context: how far along the edge the measured shift may land from the expected overlap and still be accepted. This is the acceptance the real well used; without it the peak ratio decides, and the peak ratio cannot decide -- see :data:`MIN_PEAK_RATIO`.
records.label: spacr.ops_register.register_edge#8
records.source: how far along the edge the measured shift may land from the expected overlap and still be accepted. This is the acceptance the real well used; without it the peak ratio decides, and the peak ratio cannot decide -- see :data:`MIN_PEAK_RATIO`.
records.translation: quanto ao longo da borda a mudança medida pode cair da sobreposição esperada e ainda ser aceita. Esta é a aceitação usada no poço real; sem ele a razão de pico decide, e a taxa de pico não pode decidir - ver :data:`MIN_PEAK_RATIO`.

records.context: The correction is fitted from the data rather than from a calibration file, because it depends on the stain, the filters and the exposure -- which are properties of the run, not of the instrument. For each image data channel, the spots where that image data channel dominates are found, and their mean vector becomes that image data channel's axis; the matrix of those axes, inverted, maps observed intensity back onto base identity.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.compensate_crosstalk#2
records.source: The correction is fitted FROM THE DATA rather than from a calibration file, because it depends on the stain, the filters and the exposure -- which are properties of the run, not of the instrument. For each channel, the spots where that channel dominates are found, and their mean vector becomes that channel's axis; the matrix of those axes, inverted, maps observed intensity back onto base identity.
records.translation: A correção é ajustada a partir dos dados em vez de um arquivo de calibração, porque depende da coloração, dos filtros e da exposição - que são propriedades da execução, não do instrumento. Para cada canal de dados de imagem, os pontos onde esse canal de dado de imagem domina são encontrados, e seu vetor médio se torna o eixo desse canal de informação de imagem; a matriz desses eixos, invertidos, mapeia a intensidade observada de volta à identidade base.

records.source: ``clustered`` and ``dispersed`` are per radius, not one test. Twenty radii give twenty chances to leave a 2% envelope, so a single excursion is close to meaningless; a run of them at adjacent radii is stronger evidence. The columns are deliberately named for what they are -- an excursion at this r -- rather than "significant".
records.translation: ``clustered`` e  ``dispersed`` são por raio, não um teste. Vinte raios dão vinte chances de deixar um envelope de 2%, então uma única excursão é quase sem sentido; uma sequência deles em raios adjacentes é evidência mais forte. As colunas são deliberadamente nomeadas pelo que são - uma excursão neste r - em vez de  "significant".

records.context: That product is used as a Bernoulli probability. R's ``rbinom`` returns ``NA`` for ``prob > 1`` with a warning, and the ``NA`` propagates into every downstream count. Clipping keeps the run alive, but it means the realised genes-per-microplate sample position is *below* the requested ``well_abundance_factor_mu`` for the affected genes, so the warning carries the clip count and the worst offender.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.AbundanceClippedWarning#1
records.source: That product is used as a Bernoulli probability. R's ``rbinom`` returns ``NA`` for ``prob > 1`` with a warning, and the ``NA`` propagates into every downstream count. Clipping keeps the run alive, but it means the realised genes-per-well is *below* the requested ``well_abundance_factor_mu`` for the affected genes, so the warning carries the clip count and the worst offender.
records.translation: Esse produto é usado como uma probabilidade de Bernoulli. ``rbinom`` de R retorna ``NA`` para ``prob > 1`` com um aviso, e o ``NA`` se propaga em cada contagem a jusante. Clipping mantém a execução viva, mas isso significa que a posição da amostra de genes por microplaca realizada é *below* o ``well_abundance_factor_mu`` solicitado para os genes afetados, então o aviso carrega a contagem de clipes e o pior infrator.

records.context: Missing a column the stage needs, or not exactly one row per ``(well, gene)`` pair. The downstream stages pivot the frame to a gene-by-well matrix, and a duplicated or missing pair would either silently drop observations or fill them with ``NaN`` that propagates into counts.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.MalformedPlateError#1
records.source: Missing a column the stage needs, or not exactly one row per ``(well, gene)`` pair. The downstream stages pivot the frame to a gene-by-well matrix, and a duplicated or missing pair would either silently drop observations or fill them with ``NaN`` that propagates into counts.
records.translation: Faltando uma coluna que o estágio precisa, ou não exatamente uma linha por ``(well, gene)`` par. Os estágios a jusante giram o quadro para uma matriz gene-por-poço, e um par duplicado ou ausente iria silenciosamente deixar cair observações ou preenchê-los com ``NaN`` que se propaga em contagens.

records.context: The second thing neither spaCRPower nor the port did. A microplate sample position where the microscope found three cells produces a positive *fraction* that can only take the values 0, 1/3, 2/3 and 1; its binomial standard error is around 0.27, which is three times the entire gap between the machine-learning classification model's hit-cell and background rates. It carries essentially no information about which genotypes were in it — and it enters the fit as one more observation alongside a microplate sample position with four hundred cells.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.drop_low_cell_wells#1
records.source: The second thing neither spaCRPower nor the port did. A well where the microscope found three cells produces a positive *fraction* that can only take the values 0, 1/3, 2/3 and 1; its binomial standard error is around 0.27, which is three times the entire gap between the classifier's hit-cell and background rates. It carries essentially no information about which genotypes were in it — and it enters the fit as one more observation alongside a well with four hundred cells.
records.translation: A segunda coisa que nem o spaCRPower nem o porto fizeram. Uma posição da amostra da microplaca onde o microscópio encontrou três células produz um positivo *fracção* que só pode tomar os valores 0, 1/3, 2/3 e 1; seu erro padrão binomial é de cerca de 0,27, que é três vezes a diferença total entre as taxas de células-acerto e de fundo do modelo de classificação de aprendizado de máquina. Ele carrega essencialmente nenhuma informação sobre quais genótipos estavam nele - e entra no ajuste como mais uma observação ao lado de uma posição de amostra de microplacas com quatro centenas de células.

records.context: Cross-*well* hopping — a read landing in the wrong sample entirely — is not modelled. It needs a laboratory microplate-level index layout the simulator does not carry, and within-well gene confusion is the mechanism that dilutes the effect being measured.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.misassign_reads#8
records.source: Cross-*well* hopping — a read landing in the wrong sample entirely — is not modelled. It needs a plate-level index layout the simulator does not carry, and within-well gene confusion is the mechanism that dilutes the effect being measured.
records.translation: O salto entre *poços* -- uma leitura que cai inteiramente na amostra errada -- não é modelado. Precisa de um layout de índice de nível de microplacas de laboratório que o simulador não carrega, e a confusão genética dentro do poço é o mecanismo que dilui o efeito que está sendo medido.

records.context: 1. Cells contributing DNA: ``gene_in_well * Count(lambda, var)``. This is normally far larger than the *imaged* count, because sequencing sees the whole well and the microscope sees a few microscope fields of view. 2. Amplification: one lognormal PCR factor per well, ``pcr_factor ~ LogNormal(meanlog=pcr_factor_mu, sdlog=sqrt(pcr_factor_var))``. Note both parameters are on the **log** scale despite their names; a ``pcr_factor_mu`` of 2.0 is a median amplification of ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``. The factor is per well, not per gene, because a well is one PCR reaction — which is exactly why read counts within a well are not independent. 3. Sequencing: reads are drawn from the amplified barcode pool **without replacement** (multivariate hypergeometric), because a finite flow cell reading a finite library is sampling without replacement, and modelling it as multinomial overstates how much independent information deep microplate sample positions carry. 4. **Mis-assignment**, when ``sequencing_error_rate > 0``: a fraction of the reads is credited to the wrong gene. Off by default, because it is not in the R and a silently different baseline would make every number already quoted from this module wrong. See :func:`misassign_reads` for what it models and why it always costs power.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_sequencing_plate#2
records.source: 1. Cells contributing DNA: ``gene_in_well * Count(lambda, var)``. This is normally far larger than the *imaged* count, because sequencing sees the whole well and the microscope sees a few fields. 2. Amplification: one lognormal PCR factor per well, ``pcr_factor ~ LogNormal(meanlog=pcr_factor_mu, sdlog=sqrt(pcr_factor_var))``. Note both parameters are on the **log** scale despite their names; a ``pcr_factor_mu`` of 2.0 is a median amplification of ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``. The factor is per well, not per gene, because a well is one PCR reaction — which is exactly why read counts within a well are not independent. 3. Sequencing: reads are drawn from the amplified barcode pool **without replacement** (multivariate hypergeometric), because a finite flow cell reading a finite library is sampling without replacement, and modelling it as multinomial overstates how much independent information deep wells carry. 4. **Mis-assignment**, when ``sequencing_error_rate > 0``: a fraction of the reads is credited to the wrong gene. Off by default, because it is not in the R and a silently different baseline would make every number already quoted from this module wrong. See :func:`misassign_reads` for what it models and why it always costs power.
records.translation: 1. Células que contribuem DNA: ``gene_in_well * Count(lambda, var)``. Isso normalmente é muito maior do que o *fotografado* contagem, porque o sequenciamento vê o poço inteiro e o microscópio vê alguns campos do microscópio da vista. 2. Amplificação: um fator lognormal PCR pelo poço, ``pcr_factor ~ LogNormal(meanlog=pcr_factor_mu, sdlog=sqrt(pcr_factor_var))``. Note que ambos os parâmetros estão no **log** escala apesar de seus nomes; a ``pcr_factor_mu`` de 2,0 é uma amplificação mediana de ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``. O fator é por poço, não por gene, porque um poço é uma reação PCR – e é exatamente por isso que as contagens de leitura dentro de um poço não são independentes. 3. Sequenciamento: as leituras são extraídas do pool de código de barras amplificado **sem substituição** (hipergeométrico multivariado), porque uma célula de fluxo finito lendo uma biblioteca finita é amostragem sem substituição, e modelando-a como superestimados multinomiais quanta informação independente as posições de amostra de microplacas profundas carregam. **Mis-atribuição**, quando ``sequencing_error_rate > 0``: uma fração das leituras é creditada ao gene errado. Desativado por padrão, porque não está no R e uma linha de base silenciosamente diferente tornaria cada número já citado deste módulo errado. Veja :func:`misassign_reads` pelo que modela e por que sempre custa energia.

records.context: **Probabilities above 1 are clipped, with a warning.** The Bernoulli probability is a product of two independently drawn quantities and nothing constrains it to ``[0, 1]``; at ``alpha = 0.6`` the most abundant gene's share times a ``mu = 4.6`` microplate sample position factor exceeds 1 routinely. R's ``rbinom`` returns ``NA`` there and carries on. This clips to 1 and emits one :class:`AbundanceClippedWarning` carrying the number of clipped cells and the largest offending probability, because a clipped run has a realised genes-per-microplate sample position *below* the one that was requested — the answer is still usable, but not for the parameter value written on it.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_spot_plate#3
records.source: **Probabilities above 1 are clipped, with a warning.** The Bernoulli probability is a product of two independently drawn quantities and nothing constrains it to ``[0, 1]``; at ``alpha = 0.6`` the most abundant gene's share times a ``mu = 4.6`` well factor exceeds 1 routinely. R's ``rbinom`` returns ``NA`` there and carries on. This clips to 1 and emits one :class:`AbundanceClippedWarning` carrying the number of clipped cells and the largest offending probability, because a clipped run has a realised genes-per-well *below* the one that was requested — the answer is still usable, but not for the parameter value written on it.
records.translation: **Probabilidades acima de 1 são cortadas, com um aviso.** A probabilidade de Bernoulli é um produto de duas quantidades sorteadas independentemente e nada a restringe a ``[0, 1]``; em ``alpha = 0.6`` o gene mais abundante compartilha vezes um fator de posição da amostra de ``mu = 4.6`` microplacas excede 1 rotineiramente. R's ``rbinom`` retorna ``NA`` lá e continua. Este clipes para 1 e emite um :class:`AbundanceClippedWarning` carregando o número de células cortadas e a maior probabilidade de ofensa, porque uma execução recortada tem uma posição de amostra de genes por microplaca realizada *below* a que foi solicitada - a resposta ainda é utilizável, mas não para o valor do parâmetro escrito nele.

records.context: ``worker.finished -> thread.quit`` uses a **DirectConnection**. The QThread object is created on the GUI thread. That gives it GUI thread affinity. A queued ``quit()`` goes to the *GUI* event queue rather than the worker queue. The GUI thread immediately enters ``thread.wait()`` during the "drain before closing" behavior in ``ConsolePanel.shutdown``. This blocks the event that would stop the worker and waits for the full timeout even though the worker has finished. ``QThread::quit`` is thread-safe, so the worker thread may call it directly.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.worker.make_stream_thread#4
records.source: ``worker.finished -> thread.quit`` is a **DirectConnection**. The QThread object is created here, on the GUI thread, so it is GUI-affine — a queued ``quit()`` is posted to the *GUI* thread's event queue, not to the worker's. Measured: with a queued connection, a GUI thread that goes straight into ``thread.wait()`` (which is exactly what ``ConsolePanel.shutdown`` and every "drain before closing" path does) waits out its whole timeout on a worker that has already finished, because the event that would stop the thread is sitting behind the wait. ``QThread::quit`` is explicitly thread-safe, so calling it inline from the worker thread is correct.
records.translation: ``worker.finished -> thread.quit`` usa um **DirectConnection**. O QThread O objeto é criado na thread da GUI. Isso dá-lhe GUI afinidade de thread. Uma fila ``quit()`` vai para o *GUI* fila de eventos em vez da fila de processos worker. A thread da GUI entra imediatamente ``thread.wait()`` durante o "drain before closing" comportamento em ``ConsolePanel.shutdown``. Isso bloqueia o evento que pararia o worker e aguarda o tempo limite completo, mesmo que o worker tenha terminado. ``QThread::quit`` é seguro para threads, de modo que a linha do worker pode chamá-lo diretamente.

records.context: There is deliberately **no** ``worker.deleteLater``. The worker's affinity is the background execution unit, so a deferred delete is posted into a loop that is stopping, while the panel drops the object's last Python reference from the main GUI execution path — two owners, one object. ``bridge.make_thread``'s ownership essay records the gdb trace (``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``) and the measurement: 3 crashes in 8 executions. A PySide6 object built in Python is already owned by Python; ``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` hold it in ``_retired`` until the independent execution path has exited and free it there, on the independent execution path that holds it.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.worker.make_stream_thread#5
records.source: There is deliberately **no** ``worker.deleteLater``. The worker's affinity is the worker thread, so a deferred delete is posted into a loop that is stopping, while the panel drops the object's last Python reference from the GUI thread — two owners, one object. ``bridge.make_thread``'s ownership essay records the gdb trace (``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``) and the measurement: 3 crashes in 8 runs. A PySide6 object built in Python is already owned by Python; ``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` hold it in ``_retired`` until the thread has exited and free it there, on the thread that holds it.
records.translation: Há deliberadamente **no** ``worker.deleteLater``. A afinidade do worker é a unidade de execução em segundo plano, portanto, um delete diferido é postado em um ciclo que está parando, enquanto o painel deixa cair a última referência Python do objeto do caminho de execução GUI principal dois proprietários, um objeto. O ensaio de propriedade do ``bridge.make_thread`` registra o rastreamento do gdb (``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``) e a medição: 3 falhas em 8 execuções. Um objeto PySide6 construído em Python já é de propriedade de Python; ``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` mantê-lo em ``_retired`` até que o caminho de execução independente tenha saído e liberá-lo lá, no caminho de implementação independente que o detém.

records.label: spacr.qt.annotate_engine#1
records.source: The image-processing pipeline (normalize / channel-filter / outline / colored border) and the SQLite-backed page fetch + background save worker are all Tk-free. The Qt screen wraps this with a QWidget UI.
records.translation: O fluxo de trabalho de processamento de imagem (normalizar / filtro de canal de dados de imagem / contorno / borda colorida) e a página apoiada por SQLite buscar + fundo salvar worker são todos Tk-livre. O modo de exibição de aplicativo Qt envolve isso com um QWidget UI.

records.context: A bounded five-second join used to let the screen disappear while the daemon independent execution path still owned a live SQLite connection.  That is unsafe at application shutdown: CPython can finalize the sqlite extension while the independent execution path is still inside it.  SQLite already bounds lock waits with its 30-second connection timeout, so a requested blocking stop waits for the independent execution path to close its cursor and connection completely.
records.label: spacr.qt.annotate_engine.SaveWorker.stop#1
records.source: A bounded five-second join used to let the screen disappear while the daemon thread still owned a live SQLite connection.  That is unsafe at application shutdown: CPython can finalize the sqlite extension while the thread is still inside it.  SQLite already bounds lock waits with its 30-second connection timeout, so a requested blocking stop waits for the thread to close its cursor and connection completely.
records.translation: Uma junção limitada de cinco segundos usada para deixar a tela desaparecer enquanto o caminho de execução independente do daemon ainda possuía uma conexão SQLite ao vivo. Isso não é seguro no desligamento do aplicativo: o CPython pode finalizar a extensão sqlite enquanto o caminho de execução independente ainda está dentro dele. SQLite já limita o bloqueio espera com seu tempo limite de conexão de 30 segundos, então uma parada de bloqueio solicitada espera pelo caminho de execução independente para fechar completamente seu cursor e conexão.

records.context: Extracted image region PNGs are not ordinary images. Anything spaCR wrote before the BGR fix has the first stain in the *blue* image data channel, and a 16-bit single-image data channel extracted image region opened with ``convert('RGB')`` is clipped to solid white by PIL. Both are corrected by :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`, which is therefore the only loader used here, so a hover preview shows the same colours as the annotation grid.
records.label: spacr.qt.crop_thumbs#7
records.source: Crop PNGs are not ordinary images. Anything spaCR wrote before the BGR fix has the first stain in the *blue* channel, and a 16-bit single-channel crop opened with ``convert('RGB')`` is clipped to solid white by PIL. Both are corrected by :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`, which is therefore the only loader used here, so a hover preview shows the same colours as the annotation grid.
records.translation: Região de imagem extraída PNGs não são imagens comuns. Qualquer coisa spaCR escrito antes da correção BGR tem a primeira coloração no canal de dados de imagem *blue*, e um canal de imagem única de 16 bits extraído região de imagem aberta com ``convert('RGB')`` é cortado para branco sólido por PIL. Ambos são corrigidos por :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`, que é, portanto, o único carregador usado aqui, então uma visualização do mouse mostra as mesmas cores que a grade de anotação.

records.context: The defect is not specific to the preview. CPython runs an automatic collection whenever an allocation pushes a generation past its threshold, so the collection executes on the independent execution path that allocated most recently. A Cellpose pass allocates heavily in a background execution unit, so that worker is the likely independent execution path to execute the collection and therefore to destroy unrelated widgets the main GUI execution path released earlier. The resulting crash is timing-dependent, occurs away from the code that created the cycle, and names no file.
records.label: spacr.qt.gc_policy#3
records.source: The defect is not specific to the preview. CPython runs an automatic collection whenever an allocation pushes a generation past its threshold, so the collection runs on the thread that allocated most recently. A Cellpose pass allocates heavily in a worker thread, so that worker is the likely thread to run the collection and therefore to destroy unrelated widgets the GUI thread released earlier. The resulting crash is timing-dependent, occurs away from the code that created the cycle, and names no file.
records.translation: O defeito não é específico para a visualização. CPython executa uma coleção automática sempre que uma alocação empurra uma geração além de seu limite, então a coleção é executada no caminho de execução independente que foi alocado mais recentemente. Um passe Cellpose aloca fortemente em uma unidade de execução de plano de fundo, de modo que o worker é o provável caminho independente de execução para executar a coleção e, portanto, para destruir widgets não relacionados, o caminho principal de execução  GUI é liberado anteriormente.

That is why the live preview's dropdowns were marked untranslatable outright, and why the ones that were not marked went wrong quietly -- the segmentation object box handed ``cellen`` to a worker that only knows ``cell``, and the threshold method wrote ``medelvärde`` into a setting name that only accepts ``mean``.

records.source: A combo box whose entries a handler reads back with ``currentText()`` cannot be translated: the caption moves and every comparison misses. records.translation: Uma caixa de combinação cujas entradas um manipulador lê de volta com ``currentText()`` não pode ser traduzida: a legenda se move e cada comparação falha. É por isso que os dropdowns da visualização ao vivo foram marcados como intraduzíveis, e por que aqueles que não foram marcados deram errado silenciosamente - a caixa de objeto de segmentação entregou ``cellen`` a um worker que só conhece ``cell``, e o método de limiar escreveu ``medelvärde`` em um nome de configuração que aceita apenas ``mean``.

records.translation: O valor em cache dura para um escopo, não para o processo. Um cache permanente manteria um idioma que o usuário acabou de alterar; dentro de uma única compilação síncrona, o idioma não pode mudar, porque nada mais é executado entre as chamadas. Os escopos aninhados compartilham o mapeamento de valor de chave mais externo e apenas o mais externo descarta-o, portanto, uma tela que envolve toda a sua compilação e um ajudante que se envolve usa o mesmo valor armazenado em cache.

records.context: Installed on the QApplication because the gesture has to work on every screen -- a per-screen handler works in some places and not others, which is the complaint that produced 315's warning about application filters. That warning is about COST, so the body is two integer comparisons for an event it does not want, and the wheel branch is not even reached unless Z is down. Measured at 1.2 us per uninteresting event on this machine, which is the Python call itself rather than anything this does inside it. Create the filter that scales the interface while the key is held.
records.label: spacr.qt.live_zoom.LiveZoomFilter#1
records.source: Installed on the QApplication because the gesture has to work on every screen -- a per-screen handler works in some places and not others, which is the complaint that produced 315's warning about application filters. That warning is about COST, so the body is two integer comparisons for an event it does not want, and the wheel branch is not even reached unless Z is down. Measured at 1.2 us per uninteresting event on this machine, which is the Python call itself rather than anything this does inside it. Create the filter that scales the interface while the key is held.
records.translation: Instalado no QApplication porque o gesto tem que funcionar em todas as telas - um manipulador por tela funciona em alguns lugares e não em outros, que é a queixa que produziu o aviso do 315 sobre filtros de aplicativos. Esse aviso é sobre o custo, então o corpo é duas comparações inteiras para um evento que ele não quer, e o ramo da roda não é sequer alcançado a menos que Z esteja para baixo. Medido em 1,2 nós por evento desinteressante nesta máquina, que é a chamada Python em si, em vez de qualquer coisa que isso faz dentro dela. Crie o filtro que dimensiona a interface enquanto a chave é mantida.

records.context: The OPS sample is the well's last two sites because the engine takes a well's microscope field of view count as its highest site number plus one and fits the round well to that count, so a sample has to include the last site to keep the measured 333-microscope field of view layout; see :func:`spacr.ops_engine.run_ops`. And it carries no phenotype images, because the phenotype phase aligns anchors spread over the whole well, which a two-microscope field of view sample cannot supply.
records.label: spacr.qt.ops_stitch_demo#5
records.source: The OPS sample is the well's last two sites because the engine takes a well's field count as its highest site number plus one and fits the round well to that count, so a sample has to include the last site to keep the measured 333-field layout; see :func:`spacr.ops_engine.run_ops`. And it carries no phenotype images, because the phenotype phase aligns anchors spread over the whole well, which a two-field sample cannot supply.
records.translation: A amostra de OPS é os dois últimos locais do poço porque o motor leva o campo de visão do microscópio de um poço como seu maior número de local mais um e se encaixa no poço redondo a essa contagem, assim que uma amostra tem que incluir o último local para manter o 333-microscópio medido campo de disposição; veja :func:`spacr.ops_engine.run_ops`. E não carrega nenhuma imagem do fenótipo, porque a fase do fenotipo alinha âncoras espalhadas sobre o poço inteiro, que a amostra do campo não pode fornecer.

records.source: The counterpart to :meth:`clear_finished`, which keeps what is still waiting. This one does not, so a running item is removed too, and removing the record does not stop the run. records.translation: A contrapartida para :meth:`clear_finished`, que mantém o que ainda está esperando. records.context: The banner **reads** a verdict; it does not compute one.  Opening a plate's masks takes seconds to minutes, which is too slow for every visit to the screen.  So :func:`spacr.seg_qc.read_digest` parses the CSVs the mask run already wrote, dates each one against its mask stack, and reports a card older than its masks as out of date instead of using it.  Only the *Score the masks now* button scores anything, only when pressed, and it does it on a background execution unit and writes the card so the next open is cheap again.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun#6
records.source: The banner **reads** a verdict; it does not compute one.  Opening a plate's masks takes seconds to minutes, which is too slow for every visit to the screen.  So :func:`spacr.seg_qc.read_digest` parses the CSVs the mask run already wrote, dates each one against its mask stack, and reports a card older than its masks as out of date instead of using it.  Only the *Score the masks now* button scores anything, only when pressed, and it does it on a worker thread and writes the card so the next open is cheap again.
records.translation: O banner **reads** um veredito; ele não computa um. A abertura de máscaras de uma placa leva segundos a minutos, o que é muito lento para cada visita à tela. Então :func:`spacr.seg_qc.read_digest` analisa o CSVs a execução máscara já escreveu, datas cada um contra sua pilha máscara, e relata um cartão mais velho do que suas máscaras como desatualizado em vez de usá-lo. Apenas o *Score as máscaras de fundo já escreve, as pontuações de execução do botão agora*.

records.context: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun.SegQCBanner.refresh#2
records.source: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.
records.translation: Medido em uma estação de trabalho: ``os.path.exists`` em um caminho abaixo de ``/nas_mnt`` - uma montagem ``autofs`` cuja participação estava dormindo - não havia retornado após vinte segundos, porque a estatística é o que desencadeia o automount. Esse método costumava fazer esse trabalho em linha, e ``install_qc_banner`` costumava chamá-lo dentro de ``MainWindow._build_screen``, então era toda a interface congelada em cada medida aberta. Não deixou nenhum traceback, porque um ciclo de evento parado não é um crash; foi relatado como "abrindo código de barras do mapa trava spacr", além de tremer o mouse e vislumbres de outras telas.

records.context: Every call increments ``_refresh_gen``, including a call that finds the microscope field of view empty. That is what makes a read cancellable without being interruptible: nothing can stop the worker mid-``stat``, but its answer is checked against the question before it is painted and dropped when the source has moved on. Without it, clearing src hid the banner and the read still in flight put the old laboratory microplate's verdict straight back on application view under no name at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun.SegQCBanner.refresh#4
records.source: Every call increments ``_refresh_gen``, including a call that finds the field empty. That is what makes a read cancellable without being interruptible: nothing can stop the worker mid-``stat``, but its answer is checked against the question before it is painted and dropped when the source has moved on. Without it, clearing src hid the banner and the read still in flight put the old plate's verdict straight back on screen under no name at all.
records.translation: Cada chamada incrementa ``_refresh_gen``, incluindo uma chamada que encontra o campo de visão do microscópio vazio. Isso é o que torna uma leitura cancelável sem ser interruptível: nada pode parar o worker mid-``stat``, mas sua resposta é verificada contra a pergunta antes de ser pintada e descartada quando a fonte se moveu. Sem ela, limpar o src escondeu o banner e a leitura ainda em voo não colocou o velho veredicto da microplaca de laboratório de volta à vista.

records.context: Run this on a worker. ``os.stat`` and ``shutil.disk_usage`` are the calls that wake a sleeping automount, and no cache can answer them without inventing the numbers, so the Qt caller hands this whole function to a :class:`~spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` (:func:`spacr.qt.preferences._start_disk_report`). There the wait is unbounded on purpose: a worker is allowed to wait for a mount to wake up, and the drive table is complete.
records.label: spacr.qt.resource_cleanup.disk_report#2
records.source: RUN THIS ON A WORKER. ``os.stat`` and ``shutil.disk_usage`` are the calls that wake a sleeping automount, and no cache can answer them without inventing the numbers, so the Qt caller hands this whole function to a :class:`~spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` (:func:`spacr.qt.preferences._start_disk_report`). There the wait is unbounded on purpose: a worker is allowed to wait for a mount to wake up, and the drive table is complete.
records.translation: Execute isso em um worker. ``os.stat`` e  ``shutil.disk_usage`` são as chamadas que despertam um automount adormecido, e nenhum cache pode respondê-las sem inventar os números, então o chamador Qt entrega toda essa função para um  :class:`~spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` ( :func:`spacr.qt.preferences._start_disk_report`). Lá a espera é ilimitada de propósito: um worker tem permissão para esperar por uma montagem para acordar e a tabela de unidade está completa.

records.context: The ROI feature is split across two modules. :mod:`spacr.roi` is the half that executes in a measurement worker — the geometry, the keep/drop rule and the environment route that gets both into a ``spawn`` pool. This is the half that needs a mouse: a pen that turns clicks into a :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, and a panel that turns the shapes layer into a :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` and switches the measurement filter on.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#1
records.source: The ROI feature is split across two modules. :mod:`spacr.roi` is the half that runs in a measurement worker — the geometry, the keep/drop rule and the environment route that gets both into a ``spawn`` pool. This is the half that needs a mouse: a pen that turns clicks into a :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, and a panel that turns the shapes layer into a :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` and switches the measurement filter on.
records.translation: O recurso ROI é dividido em dois módulos.  :mod:`spacr.roi` é a metade que é executada em um worker de medição - a geometria, a regra de manutenção / queda e a rota do ambiente que obtém ambos em um pool  ``spawn``. Esta é a outra metade que precisa de um mouse: uma caneta que transforma cliques em um ":class:`spacr.layers.Shape` e um painel que transforma a camada de formas em um" :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` e alterna o filtro de medição.

records.context: Switching the filter on is one call. The panel shows whether the filter will reach the worker processes that do the measuring: a filter registered only in the GUI process has no effect in a ``spawn`` worker, and the processing session then measures whole fields without a warning. :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` reports this in advance, and the panel shows the result in the warning colour when the filter will not reach the workers.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#5
records.source: Switching the filter on is one call. The panel shows whether the filter will reach the worker processes that do the measuring: a filter registered only in the GUI process has no effect in a ``spawn`` worker, and the run then measures whole fields without a warning. :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` reports this in advance, and the panel shows the result in the warning colour when the filter will not reach the workers.
records.translation: Ligar o filtro é uma chamada. O painel mostra se o filtro alcançará os processos de trabalho que fazem a medição: um filtro registrado apenas no processo GUI não tem efeito em um worker  ``spawn`` e a sessão de processamento mede campos inteiros sem um aviso.  :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` relata isso com antecedência e o painel mostra o resultado na cor de aviso quando o filtro não atingirá os processos worker.

records.context: **Background execution.** Scanning ND2 headers takes seconds and conversion takes minutes. Both operations use :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`. Completion calls *:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`* on the GUI object instead of a closure. ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted during worker execution; a connected closure would construct widgets there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.convert#6
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Scanning a plate's worth of ND2 headers takes seconds; converting takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **A execução de background.**A varredura dos cabeçalhos ND2 leva segundos e a conversão leva minutos. Ambas as operações usam :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`. Chamadas de conclusão *:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`* sobre o GUI objeto em vez de um fechamento. ``PipelineWorker.finished`` é emitido durante a execução do worker; um fechamento conectado construiria widgets lá. ``threaded=False``.

Um plano que ficou obsoleto – porque uma sessão de processamento escrita no projeto enquanto a tela estava aberta – é recusada pelo módulo, não por este arquivo, que é onde essa verificação pertence.

records.context: This walks the project, and the dialog does not call it. :meth:`spacr.data_manager.PrunePlan.file_list` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate each time it is asked, which can block for many seconds, so nothing on the main GUI execution path may call this. The dialog builds the same string in two pieces instead: :meth:`_heading` at once, then :meth:`_with_the_files` on the walk that :meth:`_start_the_file_list` sent to a worker.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.data_manager.ConfirmDeleteDialog.describe#1
records.source: This walks the project, and the dialog does not call it. :meth:`spacr.data_manager.PrunePlan.file_list` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate each time it is asked, which can block for many seconds, so nothing on the GUI thread may call this. The dialog builds the same string in two pieces instead: :meth:`_heading` at once, then :meth:`_with_the_files` on the walk that :meth:`_start_the_file_list` sent to a worker.
records.translation: Isso percorre o projeto, e a caixa de diálogo não o chama. :meth:`spacr.data_manager.PrunePlan.file_list` executa ``os.walk`` sobre cada candidato cada vez que é solicitado, o que pode bloquear por muitos segundos, então nada no caminho de execução GUI principal pode chamar isso. A caixa de ferramentas constrói a mesma cadeia de caracteres em duas partes: :meth:`_heading` de uma só vez, depois :meth:`_with_the_files` na caminhada que :meth:`_start_the_file_list` enviou para um worker.

records.context: The screen runs the same embedding engine, :mod:`spacr.embeddings`, that the Python API exposes, without requiring any Python.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#2
records.source: The screen runs the same embedding engine, :mod:`spacr.embeddings`, that the Python API exposes, without requiring any Python.
records.translation: A tela executa o mesmo mecanismo de incorporação, :mod:`spacr.embeddings`, que o  Python  API expõe, sem exigir qualquer Python.

records.context: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#3
records.source: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.translation: **Para que serve.** Dando a cada objeto um vetor que nenhum rótulo entrou. O painel medido diz o quão grande é uma célula e quão brilhante cada coloração era; uma incorporação descreve como a célula se parece, em algumas centenas de números um backbone pré-treinado produz sem ser dito o que procurar. Ele complementa o painel em vez de substituí-lo: um fenótipo que nenhuma captura de coluna medida ainda pode ser representada no vetor.

records.context: **The channel policy is the first control on the screen.** How channels are combined must not be decided implicitly by whatever the backbone expects. Per-channel encoding keeps the channel in every column name and costs N forward passes; projection mixes the channels into three and costs one. Those produce columns of identical width and dtype that mean entirely different things, so the screen makes the choice explicit and says what each one costs.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#8
records.source: **The channel policy is the first control on the screen.** How channels are combined must not be decided implicitly by whatever the backbone expects. Per-channel encoding keeps the channel in every column name and costs N forward passes; projection mixes the channels into three and costs one. Those produce columns of identical width and dtype that mean entirely different things, so the screen makes the choice explicit and says what each one costs.
records.translation: **A política do canal é o primeiro controle na tela.** Como os canais são combinados não deve ser decidido implicitamente pelo que a espinha dorsal espera. A codificação por canal mantém o canal em cada nome da coluna e os custos N passam adiante; a projeção mistura os canais em três e custa um. Aqueles produzem colunas de largura e dtype idênticos que significam coisas totalmente diferentes, então a tela torna a escolha explícita e diz o que cada um custa.

records.context: The extracted image region loader above the encoder controls is the screen's entry point: :mod:`spacr.crop_loader` plans the selection, this screen pages through it on a background execution unit, and each finished load calls :meth:`set_crops`.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings.EmbeddingsScreen#1
records.source: The crop loader above the encoder controls is the screen's entry point: :mod:`spacr.crop_loader` plans the selection, this screen pages through it on a worker thread, and each finished load calls :meth:`set_crops`.
records.translation: O carregador de região de imagem extraído acima dos controles do codificador é o ponto de entrada da tela: :mod:`spacr.crop_loader` planeja a seleção, esta tela passa por ela em uma unidade de execução de plano de fundo e cada carga terminada chama  :meth:`set_crops`.

records.source: Build the screen: the controls above, the preview table below.
records.translation: Crie a tela: os controles acima, a tabela de visualização abaixo.

records.context: The load runs as two jobs. Planning is a count and a select, so it comes back in milliseconds and the screen can say what was matched -- or why nothing was -- before committing to read a single pixel. Only then does the second job start, and it reports after every page.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings.EmbeddingsScreen.load_crops#1
records.source: The load runs as two jobs. Planning is a count and a select, so it comes back in milliseconds and the screen can say what was matched -- or why nothing was -- before committing to read a single pixel. Only then does the second job start, and it reports after every page.
records.translation: A carga é executada como dois trabalhos. O planejamento é uma contagem e uma seleção, então ele volta em milissegundos e a tela pode dizer o que foi combinado - ou por que nada foi - antes de se comprometer a ler um único pixel. Só então o segundo trabalho começa e ele é reportado depois de cada página.

records.translation: Dê à tela uma pilha ``(objects, height, width, channels)``.
